deck_title: Enterprise 3D Packaging CAD Dieline Unwrap, Foil/Emboss PBR & Prepress Pipeline: 2D FEFCO/ECMA UV-First + Spot Craft Masks + 3D Hinge Fold (c_pack = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Unprintable T2I Box

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise 3D Packaging CAD Dieline & Prepress pipeline evaluation (generating 300-DPI artwork on flat 2D FEFCO/ECMA CAD dieline UV islands with 3mm bleed, compiling vector spot-foil/emboss paths into both CMYK+Spot prepress PDF plates and 3D PBR Metallic/Normal maps, and folding the 3D box along parametric crease hinges so amortized unit cost c_pack(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_pack = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive perspective T2I 3D box generation (which produces an unprintable foreshortened bitmap with garbled barcodes, forcing manual Adobe Illustrator reconstruction and inflating cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-panel UV quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: FMCG, cosmetics, luxury tea/wine gift boxes, and electronics packaging pipelines requiring both 3D e-commerce hero renders and 300-DPI print-ready CMYK+Spot PDFs
Generating AIGC illustrations directly on flat FEFCO/ECMA 2D CAD dielines with 3mm bleed and cross-crease continuity
Compiling vector hot-foil, blind-emboss, and spot-UV varnish layers into both offset printing spot plates and Blender/Three.js PBR Metallic/Normal/Clearcoat maps
not_for: Generating perspective 3D box photos via raw T2I prompts when the factory requires a flat unfolded 300-DPI CMYK dieline
Letting diffusion models rasterize EAN-13/UPC barcodes or FDA/GB nutritional tables
